messages:
maya-marketing: Pushed a fresh draft of the product launch blog to Drive. Need quick-pass: legal on claims, final hero CTA copy, and HubSpot form mapping for the webinar. Aim to publish tomorrow AM.

oliver-growth: My CTA recs: primary 'Register for Demo' secondary 'Try Hosted API'. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=may_launch. Also want a tiny lead checkbox for webinar updates.

jin-product: Bench numbers are in the appendix. Suggest wording: 'In our internal benchmark on p4d (batch=4), Redwood lowered per-token cost by up to 2.4x vs baseline.' Add method link.

kevin-legal: That wording is ok if method link is present. No absolutes. Add a footnote with the Drive methodology.

zoe-design: Uploaded two hero art options and social banners (1200x628, 1080x1080). Which CTA style for mobile? stacked or inline?

maya-marketing: Use stacked for mobile. Include small 'SLA-backed latency' badge.

publish-bot: Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/5512346789. Snapshot at 5512346805.

oliver-growth: HubSpot suggestion: form id a1b2c3, hidden fields source=launch_blog, campaign=may_launch, add to list 'Launch Web - Registrants'. Will set webhook to #sales-inbound.

jin-product: I added the HW and command snippet used in testing to the appendix.

kevin-legal: Reviewed appendix. Approve numeric claim as written with link.

maya-marketing: Great. Owners: design @zoe, growth @oliver, legal @kevin, product @jin. Locking copy at 4pm PT. Publishing at 9:30am PT tomorrow if no objections.
